title: EXL3 projections: 1 to 16 rows times trellis tiles decoded on the fly between the matrix's Hadamard rotations, and a dequantization to BF16 for prompts

gemv.what: the rows rotated (x su H in FP32, stored in FP16); a block's WARPS x STRIPS neighbouring 16-column tile strips over its split of the input tiles, their slices copied into shared memory by 16-byte cp.async, STAGES stages in flight; each tile decoded once into the A operand of an m16n8k16 MMA (FP16, FP32 accumulators) whose B operand is up to 8 activation rows a column group; the splits added in order and the result rotated (y' H sv)

SPLITS.what: contiguous parts of the input's tiles, one a block row, added in part order (0: 48 warps a multiprocessor, each part at least two stages)

STRIPS.what: neighbouring tile strips a warp decodes, the activations loaded once for them

ROWS.what: input rows of the block's tile slice a stage copies
